revision.refused: No changes committed. The proposed largest-stored-x default, smaller-y tie-break, and removal of admissible-member selection are not supported across rounds. Round 1 includes a recorded choice of a smaller-x blue cube before a nearby-column red cube, contradicting a universal largest-x priority. Matching this round's two choices does not establish a general trajectory-matching convention. Introducing that default would replace the previously corrected selection rule with another unsupported priority. Memory membership and updates remain correct and need no additional field or serialization change. Exact recorded-object prediction remains unresolved; it requires an independently supported pickup priority or evaluation accepting any eligible remaining target.
